clue.text: Where transactions might appear as odd bits of debt written out in full

definitions.text: Where transactions might appear as odd bits of debt written out in full

parts.words: Where transactions might appear as odd bits of debt written out in full

explanation.surface: An accountant's ledger where debts appear in scattered fragments, then are fully recorded.
explanation.walkthrough: The first, third letters of 'debt' are D and B; read as an abbreviation, DB expands to the full words of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A daily ledger is the accounting record in which each transaction is first entered as it happens.

clue.text: Some prompting needed for this, perhaps
